record.question:
With reference to the economic revolution in India, consider the following pairs:
1. Blue Revolution — Fish production
2. Grey Revolution — Onions, Prawn production
3. Pink Revolution — Fertilizers production
4. Black Revolution — Petroleum production
Which of the above pairs is/are correctly matched?
record.explanation: Answer D: Only 1&4. Pairs 1 and 4 are correctly matched: Blue Revolution—fish production and Black Revolution—petroleum products. Grey Revolution is associated with fertilizer production, not onions/prawn; Pink Revolution is associated with onions/prawn (among other stated formulations), not fertilizer. Thus only 1 and 4 are correct (option d). Reference: https://www.fibkerala.gov.in/sites/default/files/inline-files/KKE%20%202023%20DECEMBER.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
